history.period: Contemporary; Khandoli Dam/park developed as a tourism attraction
history.summary: FLAG - UNCERTAIN IDENTITY: no documented temple named exactly 'Khandoli Temple' was found in any source; Khandoli is a hill/dam/park ~7-11 km north-east of Giridih (Bengabad block), developed as a tourist spot with boating, rock-climbing, parasailing and a 600-ft hillock with watch towers. The only supporting reference for a shrine is a Wanderlog listing noting Khandoli Park 'also has a temple dedicated to Lord Shiva'. This file therefore documents the Khandoli Park complex with coordinates at the park as an approximation. Locality listings show village shrines near Khandoli village (Vishwakarma, Bajrangbali, Durga, Shiv-Hanuman) but none is documented as 'Khandoli Temple'. History, deity details and antiquity are unverified - treat as provisional.

name: Khandoli Temple
town_description: Giridih, literally 'land of hills', is the headquarters of Giridih district in Jharkhand, a mining town on the Chota Nagpur plateau surrounded by forested plateaus; Khandoli Park and Dam lie about 7-11 km north-east of the town towards Bengabad.

travel.airport: Ranchi (Birsa Munda Airport) is the nearest major airport (~190 km); Dhanbad has a small airport (~60 km).
travel.railway: Giridih railway station is the nearest (New Giridih/Maheshmunda Junction nearby); taxis/autos run to Khandoli Park.
travel.road: Khandoli Park is 7-11 km north-east of Giridih town on the Bengabad road; local taxis and autos available from the station and bus stand.

visitor_information.best_time: September to March; winter is peak picnic season.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Khandoli Park has ticketed entry during daytime hours (exact hours unverified - check locally).
